title: Agentic Router: An Execution-Grounded Continual Learning Approach With Memory
title_zh: Agentic Router：一种带记忆、基于执行反馈的持续学习方法
abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents provide a promising interface for command-line-based network operations, but a plausible command may still fail or introduce operational risk after execution. Existing approaches mainly focus on command generation or final configuration correctness, and do not use execution-grounded experience to jointly improve candidate coverage and action selection. We propose an execution-grounded dual-path consequence-aware agent for CLI-based SONiC operations, which generates multiple complete actions, predicts their execution consequences, and selects the final action through utility- and risk-aware reranking. The proposal-side path abstracts reusable operational lessons into retrievable guidance to improve feasible-action coverage without modifying the proposal LLM, while the selection-side path adapts the consequence predictor through session-level LoRA updates using real SSH feedback to improve conditional selection quality. Experiments over multi-turn SONiC operation sessions with different Qwen3 proposal models show that the framework improves feasible-action coverage and top-1 execution success, and that the two adaptation paths provide complementary gains over interaction.
abstract_zh: 本文面向基于命令行界面（CLI）的 SONiC 网络运维场景，提出一种以执行结果为依据、具备后果感知能力的双路径 LLM Agent 框架。现有方法多关注命令生成或最终配置正确性，但一个看似合理的命令在真实执行后仍可能失败或带来运维风险。该方法首先生成多个完整候选操作，再预测其执行后果，并通过同时考虑效用与风险的重排序机制选择最终动作。框架包含两条自适应路径：在 proposal 侧，将可复用的运维经验抽象为可检索指导，以提升可行动作覆盖率，且无需修改 proposal LLM；在 selection 侧，利用真实 SSH 反馈进行会话级 LoRA 更新，持续适配后果预测器，从而提升条件动作选择质量。在多轮 SONiC 运维会话和不同 Qwen3 proposal models 上的实验表明，该框架能够提升可行动作覆盖率与 top-1 执行成功率，两条适应路径在交互过程中提供互补增益。
key_points_zh: 提出 execution-grounded dual-path consequence-aware agent，用真实命令执行结果而非仅靠静态预测来改进网络运维决策。
proposal-side path 将历史执行经验沉淀为可检索的操作指导，提升候选命令的可行性覆盖率，同时不需要微调 proposal LLM。
selection-side path 基于真实 SSH feedback 对 consequence predictor 进行会话级 LoRA 更新，增强对候选动作后果的判断与选择能力。
通过 utility- and risk-aware reranking 在多个完整候选操作中选择最终动作，显式权衡任务收益与潜在运维风险。
在多轮 SONiC operations 和不同 Qwen3 模型实验中，该方法提升 feasible-action coverage 与 top-1 execution success，且两条路径具有互补效果。

llm_assessment.comment: The execution-grounded memory and continual adaptation loop is relevant, but the network-operations vertical limits domain centrality.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 其基于执行反馈的记忆与持续适应闭环具有相关性，但网络运维垂直场景削弱了领域核心契合度。
